basic_info.description: Welcome to 150 Athens Street, a charming single-family home located in San Francisco's vibrant Excelsior District. Brimming with potential, this well-maintained residence offers classic charm and a flexible layout, ready for your personal updates. The main level features a spacious living room with coved ceilings and large windows that fill the space with natural light. A separate dining area flows into the original kitchen, offering a solid foundation for future renovation. Two well-sized bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upper level, all with carpeted flooring throughout. Downstairs, a bonus room with a separate entrance adds flexibility, ideal for a home office, guest space, or potential ADU conversion (buyer to verify). The garage includes interior access, laundry hookups, and ample room for storage. A low-maintenance backyard offers outdoor space for relaxing or gardening. Conveniently located just blocks from Mission Street shops and eateries, McLaren Park, public transit, and freeway access, 150 Athens Street presents a fantastic opportunity to customize a home in one of San Franciscos most connected neighborhoods.
